evals.prompt: Recommend a starter tmux config for a clean, minimal aesthetic.
evals.expected_output: Recommends Oh My Tmux!, mooks, or tmux-extra from the Configuration category.

evals.prompt: Find a tmux theme that matches the tokyo-night color scheme.
evals.expected_output: Recommends the tokyo-night tmux theme from the Themes category.

evals.prompt: Recommend a tmux status-bar widget that shows battery level.
evals.expected_output: Recommends a battery status-bar widget from the Status Bar category.
expectations: Maps to the Status Bar category

evals.prompt: Which tmux session manager should I use if I want YAML configs?
evals.expected_output: Recommends tmuxinator or tmuxp (YAML config style) from Tools and session management.
expectations: Maps to Tools and session management

evals.prompt: Find a tmux plugin for system clipboard / yank support.
evals.expected_output: Recommends tmux-yank from the Plugins category.
expectations: Distinguishes official tmux-plugins org from community

evals.prompt: Recommend an fzf-driven tmux session picker.
evals.expected_output: Recommends sesh, sessionx, or another fzf-driven session manager.
expectations: Maps to Tools and session management

evals.prompt: Find a tmux status widget for git status in the current branch.
expectations: Maps to the Status Bar category

evals.prompt: Recommend a tmux book for a deep dive.
evals.expected_output: Recommends tmux 2: Productive Mouse-Free Development or The Tao of tmux.

evals.prompt: Find a tmux plugin for AI / Claude integration.
evals.expected_output: Recommends the AI/Claude/LLM tmux plugin from the Plugins category.

evals.prompt: How do I autostart tmux on SSH login?
evals.expected_output: Recommends the autostart-on-SSH tutorial from Tutorials.
